name: V8 code range: 128MiB JIT reservation that must land within 2048MiB of the embedded blob / .text
required_postconditions: the reserved code range lies entirely inside GetPreferredRegion(2048 MiB): a window centred on the embedded builtins blob (or, without one, on a function address in the static binary)
every call from generated code to a builtin is therefore reachable with a PC-relative displacement no wider than kMaxPCRelativeCodeRangeInMB
the range is reserved kNoAccessWillJitLater and individual pages are later made executable - reserve and commit are distinct states
requested <= kMaximalCodeRangeSize (128MiB here) and requested >= kMinimumCodeRangeSize (64MiB)

failure_sink.description: 16 hinted attempts walk backwards through the preferred region (code-range.cc:226-246). If none lands inside it, V8 keeps the last successful reservation anyway and only notes the miss at code-range.cc:267 (`!preferred_region.contains(region())`). The reservation succeeds; what degrades is code generation, which must then emit indirect calls to builtins instead of PC-relative ones. Nothing aborts and nothing is returned to the embedder.

source_locations.symbol: auto preferred_region = GetPreferredRegion(kRadiusInMB, kPageSize);  - centred on Isolate::CurrentEmbeddedBlobCode() (code-range.cc:432)

extraction_limitations: the load-bearing constraint is 'this reservation must be within +/-2048MiB of a DIFFERENT region (the embedded blob), whose address is only known at runtime'. This schema has no way to relate one mapping to another: there is no reference region, no maximum displacement, no notion of a second address at all. required_postconditions carries it as prose only
the 16-attempt loop is a search for a satisfying address, not a retry after a transient error; retries_on_failure/max_retries is the closest encoding and means something different

x_campaign.rationale: The probe says anonymous executable mappings, the RW->RX transition and W+X are all available and no JIT entitlement is needed, so the protection rules stay quiet; the verdict should come from rule_reserve_commit firing RS-VM-0012 against posix_lazy. The +/-2048MiB proximity constraint - the only thing that can actually degrade this reservation - will not appear.
